intro.text: A bounty hunter from the forts of Threnody who has spent four months on the trail of Chesterton Divide.

items.text: With seven other fort bounty hunters he followed Silence and William Ann on Chesterton's trail. When his scout Tobias found the pair with the body, his band moved in armed for a fight, and Silence let them take it.

Silence's gunpowder trap turned the shades on his band. Badly hurt, he caught up with her and held William Ann hostage for Silence's silver, until a crossbow bolt hit his shoulder and his knife drew blood. He pushed William Ann through a shade, but the shades killed him.

appearance.text: He wears fine fortfolk clothes and a hat, carries a knife and a cudgel, and rides a horse through the forest. He has a smug air and a grin Silence thinks looks false. A shade's touch leaves him with a milky eye and a blackened face.
